turns.text: I reported a scrape on the print, and your reply said it was part of the artwork. It's a raised scratch across the ink. I'd like to dispute that decision.

I'm sorry about this. I've passed your dispute to a colleague, who will take over and review the earlier decision. It will help if you have your order number and the email on the order ready, along with a photo of the scratch.
